To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the literature review process can be made more transparent by using visual displays to organize information and to facilitate the interpretation of information.
the literature review process can be enhanced by visually displaying information extracted from the literature review.

(1) Miles and Huberman’s (1994) displays can be used to visually represent the results of literature reviews and (2) the use of qualitative data analysis programs can be used to facilitate these visual representations
In summary, our research is concerned with
the visual representation of information extracted for literature review. (Contains 2 tables and 1 figure.)
the visual display of information extracted from literature review.

the development and application of a visual framework that can be used for the purpose of displaying information extracted during literature reviews in a visually appealing and reader friendly manner.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the visual displays we propose are an effective way of organizing, summarizing, and presenting information extracted from the literature.
the use of Miles and Huberman (1994)'s within and cross case analysis methods in the context of literature reviews can be very beneficial to researchers.
this article is a step by step demonstration of how to visually display information extracted from the literature review process.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have provided a step by step procedure to display information extracted for literature review via visual displays and have demonstrated how to use a computer program to facilitate this process.
the use of visual displays is a very useful and effective way for researchers to present the findings from their literature reviews.
we have provided a visual display for the information that is extracted from the literature review process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the visual displays we propose are useful for displaying information extracted during the literature review process.
qualitative researchers can use the visual displays we propose to enhance the readability of their literature reviews and to make their literature reviews more visually appealing to their readers.
visual displays can be used to enhance and facilitate the literature review process.
